# Kicksecure

> A secure by default operating system with the latest security research in place.

## Key pages
- [Download](https://www.kicksecure.com/wiki/Download): FREE download of Kicksecure. Kicksecure can be installed on a physical machine as the host operating system (OS), as a guest OS inside a virtual machine, or as a portable host OS on a USB data stick.
- [About](https://www.kicksecure.com/wiki/About): Kicksecure Overview. Security by Design, Usability by default. A Hardened Fork of Debian.
- [Docs](https://www.kicksecure.com/wiki/Documentation): A Crash Course in Computer Security
- [Community](https://forums.kicksecure.com/)
- [Support](https://www.kicksecure.com/wiki/Support): Various Ways to get Help with Kicksecure. Free, Plus and Premium Support available.

## Optional
